body: Matrix labels row: geomText data labels already compile to keyed TargetInfo (InteractionCoverageSuite), so they are addressable marks rather than duplicate PlotPart metadata. I will add real-browser label hover/activation checks. Proposal requires addressable labels, not a second enum discriminant; suggest receipt-backed PASS for data-label targets while preserving typed title/axis/strip parts. Appearance API now WidgetOptions(appearance=WidgetAppearance(...)) with validated colors/opacity/transition, plus external CSS overrides.
